gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-old-perm: Wiry, spaced-out tech: Quantum keeps arms and legs at a constant width, loose and clean. Noto Sans Old Permic does the softer work, with rounded forms open to the side.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-old-sogd: Clean describes Quantum, with contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal and loose, generous spacing. And Noto Sans Old Sogdian brings the standout trait of the pair: a tall x-height nearly touching cap height.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Quantum cuts every stem and curve from one gauge of tubing, loose and unmistakably techy. Noto Sans Oriya saves its strength for generous curve gaps and small letters nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-osage: Quantum is the showpiece, spaghetti-like strokes all the same width. Noto Sans Osage does the filling, its inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves never closing up across the line.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-psalter-: Pipe-like strokes, loose and techy: that is Quantum in a line. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi sits against it with gaping mouths on the e and barely rising capitals, a softer foil.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Clean in feel, Quantum holds its stems with no pressure swells where the eye slows down, spaced loose and open. Noto Sans Soyombo then reads easily, big x-height and open curves.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Open curves leave daylight, like a rope's bight, so the body text reads lightly. Noto Sans Sunuwar carries that, while Quantum, with a rolling-ball pen's single-width trail, does the showy part.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Crisp, loose, techy: Quantum keeps its strokes put from stem to curve. Noto Sans Syriac Western then reads easily, its terminals held far from the stroke and small letters thick with height like bundled cable.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Thread-like and spacious, Quantum stitches its strokes along a path, clean and a bit techy. Noto Sans Tagalog adds generous curve gaps and a dominant middle zone, the pair's standout quality.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-tamil-su: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Quantum leads in rounded-rod single weight, and the text below reads smoothly.
